title: QCDIAG: fix Coverity unsafe_xml_parse_config issue and general improvements
description:
Main purpose:
- Fixing UNSAFE_XML_PARSE_CONFIG warning.
- Eliminating XML_PARSE_NOENT flag.

```
CID 1681723:         Miscellaneous  (UNSAFE_XML_PARSE_CONFIG)
XML parse option should not have flag "XML_PARSE_NOENT" set, which is vulnerable to XML external entity attack.
```

Minor corrections or Code improvements:
- Minor improvements on the overl XML related code.
- Renaming 2 value_string variables
- Minor update on dissect_qcdiag_log_config_hdr()

Examples: [qcdiag.pcapng](/uploads/cc5672c6e7ad502c01cdecf1acfbeb33/qcdiag.pcapng), [qcdiag_log_wcdma.pcapng](/uploads/2f32e91a5505742a250f187b95a2a5bd/qcdiag_log_wcdma.pcapng)

Additional participants: @laf0rge, @osmith42, @lynxis, @martin.r.mathieson

Coverity CID 1681723

AI-Assisted: no
